items.problem: Migrated `async void` event handlers swallow exceptions from WinRT APIs that throw on WinUI 3 desktop, leaving present-yet-dead controls (Register Task did nothing).
items.evidence: migration-score.json Background activity=partial, winui_responded=false ('invoked, produced no output/status change; newTokens 0'); Scenario4_BackgroundActivity.xaml.cs:68 async void handler with no try/catch.
items.root_cause: SKILL.md Defensive-UI rule only covered page-init blank screens, not async void event handlers; a thrown exception in async void is silent.
items.change: Extended the existing 'Defensive UI for device-dependent features' rule in SKILL.md to require try/catch around every migrated `async void` event-handler body, routing the exception message to the same status/notify surface used on success.
items.expected_effect: Handlers calling APIs that throw show a visible error instead of a dead control, keeping the control responsive for parity.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, requirement 'Background activity / Register Task' goes partial->pass (winui_responded=true) because the click surfaces a status message; no present-yet-dead controls flagged by the parity behavioral check.

items.problem: Out-of-process UWP background APIs (BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync, TaskEntryPoint components, ActivitySensorTrigger) throw at runtime in WinUI 3 desktop but were never flagged by tooling nor documented as throwing.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:656 keeps 'await BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync();' unmodified; the only injected TODO (migrate-003) landed on the BackgroundTaskBuilder line, not the throwing call.
items.root_cause: unsupported-api-inventory.json IBackgroundTask pattern matched only the builder, so no TODO was injected on the throwing call; PATTERNS.md#background-tasks named the replacement builder but gave no runtime-behavior warning.
items.change: Added `BackgroundExecutionManager` to the background-tasks inventory pattern (so Initialize-UwpMigration injects a TODO on the throwing line and Validate flags it), and added a runtime warning to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#background-tasks that these calls throw and must be guarded / migrated to the in-process builder.
items.expected_effect: The migration agent is routed to the background-tasks anchor at the exact line that breaks and told it throws, prompting a guarded/adapted implementation instead of a verbatim copy.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, a `// TODO[migrate-NNN]: see PATTERNS.md#background-tasks` appears on the BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync() line, and Validate-UwpMigration reports the background-tasks adaptation; the Register Task control is no longer dead.
